grammar.summary: 本课学习过去完成时叙事与 enjoy/hate 情感动词。

points.title: 过去完成时先时链
points.explanation: By the time he had finished his speech, everyone was bored. had finished 先于 was。by the time 表"到……时候为止"。

examples.en: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this.

points.title: make sb. do 使役结构
points.explanation: The funny speech made everyone laugh. make + 宾语 + 动词原形（不带 to）；被动 be made to do 要还原 to。

examples.cn: 大家都因他的笑话而发笑。
